market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham are a firmly mid-table Premier League side with strong financial backing and a talented squad (Bowen, Paqueta, Kudus). They have not been relegated since 2011 and finished 9th last season; current 2024-25 standings show them well clear of the drop zone. The implied 34.5% chance is far above a realistic 10% probability for a team of their stature, indicating the market is overly fearful.
evidence_points: West Ham finished 9th in 2023-24 and are outside the relegation zone in 2024-25.
The club has robust finances and no points deductions or systemic crisis.
Historical relegation frequency for teams of West Ham's profile is low (~10% per season).
sources_consulted: Historical relegation data for mid-table PL clubs
